clips.title: The story
paras: Crank Fizzlebub has found that Zanzil's Mixture blended into stout makes a strong drink, called Fool's Stout. He thinks it will be just what Kravel needs. You carry it to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats, and quickly, because it will not stay fresh.

Crank Fizzlebub has found that Zanzil's Mixture, blended into stout, gives a strong drink, the Fool's Stout. Crank thinks it will be just what Kravel needs, and wants to hear how it works. You carry it back to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats.
Crank warns you against holding on to the stout for long. The mixture has an odd effect on the stout's yeast, pushing it into high gear, so the drink will not keep fresh forever.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation. A Fool's Stout. I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.
And friend, don't keep this stuff too long without using it. Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear. So it won't stay fresh forever.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Was Fizzlebub able to help us?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wonderful! Fizzlebub came through! I'll remember that next time I see him.
And thank you, friend. You're doing a great job, and we both stand to make a lot of money from this...
